title: How sharp is the grokking phase transition under singular-learning-theory predictions vs. observed loss?

original_idea.body:
# Grokking Phase Transition: SLT Order Parameter vs Loss

Sweep weight decay; track test-loss transition and SLT order parameter, test whether jumps coincide.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: phase transitions as capability-emergence early warning but the safety-outcome link is broad.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Grokking reproduction plus LLC/order-parameter tracking; some SLT sophistication needed but guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: do order-parameter jumps coincide with loss transition across weight decay.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: toy models, open tooling; though grokking phase transitions are actively studied.

low_compute.reasoning: Minutes per run on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Very recent SLT grokking-phase-transition work directly studies this.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent SLT papers directly characterize the grokking order parameter.
